messages:
kevin: FYI found a small but visible underbilling cluster for several EU tenants yesterday (~0.8%). looks like some ingestion events were dropped at aggregation window boundary. digging in now.

sam: dropped by TTL or rejected by schema?

kevin: TTL eviction at the aggregator watermark. events arrived ~20-75s after their source_ts due to host clocks drifting during a rolling deploy, so they landed after the allowed lateness and were purged.

nils: can you paste an example event?

kevin: example: 
```
event_id=ab3f7e
tenant=eu-ops-19
source_ts=2025-11-18T21:58:50Z
ingest_ts=2025-11-18T21:59:37Z
watermark=2025-11-18T21:59:00Z
action=ttl_evict
```

tony: that's annoying. our allowed_lateness is 30s by default in stream-agg, right?

kevin: yep. but some infra hosts spiked clock skew during the deploy, pushing them past 30s.

anya: immediate options? bump lateness, accept and tag late events, or backfill from source. each has tradeoffs.

sam: bump to 2m for EU only? or route late events to a separate "late_ingest" topic that we can tally without mixing into primary counts.

nils: beware state size growth if we bump lateness; also late events increase duplicate surface for downstream billing unless we fingerprint.

kevin: proposed micro-plan: 1) temporarily set allowed_lateness=120s for EU ingestion shards; 2) aggregator emits billing_event type=late_token for any event accepted after watermark; 3) run a reconciler job (dry-run first) to compute compensating invoice items with strong idempotency keys.

anya: reconciler needs: (tenant, billing_window, source_fingerprint) idempotency; dry-run CSV to s3; a toggle in invoice-preview UI so CS/product can inspect before apply.

sam: alerting: create a grafana alert on `sum(late_token) / sum(expected_tokens)` > 0.002 for 1h for EU shards. callout channel #billing-alerts.

kevin: billing-bot: can you post the query strings and dashboard links?

billing-bot: invoice_delta_ratio: `sum(rate(invoice_delta_charged[1h]))/sum(rate(expected_charge[1h]))` ; late_tokens: `sum(billing_events{type=\"late_token\", region=\"eu\"})`. Dashboards in Grafana > Billing > Late-Arrivals. :white_check_mark:

nils: implementation notes for reconciler: ensure it writes a `compensation_reference` into ledger and ledger enforces uniqueness on that field. reconciler should only apply if `reconciler.apply_compensations` flag=true.

anya: UI: in Invoice Preview add a per-tenant toggle "Show late-arrival compensation suggestions (canary)". previews should be marked draft and not affect totals shown to end-users unless applied.

ops: will need a short maintenance window to roll the lateness change to EU. prefer low-traffic hours.

kevin: suggested timeline: shadow roll in 20m, 2h canary across 5 staging tenants, if metrics look good then full EU prod roll in 3h. can someone own canary tenants?

sam: I can pick canaries — low-risk, medium-volume EU test tenants. will DM the list.

nils: how long should reconciler look back? my suggestion: initial backfill window last 12 hours, dry-run only. then extend if safe.

anya: add a preview tag `late-arrivals-suggested` in invoice preview when dry-run results are present so CS can filter. also email opt-in to customers who want to see drafts.

kevin: questions about duplicates: if the late event arrives later again (e.g., from a retry), how do we avoid double compensation?

sam: design: reconciler constructs fingerprint = sha256(source_event_id + source_ts + tenant). write compensation_reference = fingerprint + reconciler_run_ts. ledger should dedupe on compensation_reference and also mark original event as reconciled in a separate registry table.

nils: make sure reconciler marks compensating rows with metadata: origin=late-arrivals-reconciler, run_id, dry_run boolean. ledger team to confirm ingestion schema.

ops: rollback plan?

kevin: rollbacks: revert allowed_lateness, disable late_token emission, pause reconciler. reconciliation apply should be manual and gated; if something goes wrong we can run a negative-compensations job to offset.

sam: testing checklist: unit tests for fingerprint collisions (none), integration test in shadow cluster, shadow-mode E2E with cloned events for 4h, canary on 1-5 tenants for 6h, monitor duplicate_charge_rate and invoice_delta_ratio.

nils: I'll own the reconciler code and dry-run. will output s3://billing-previews/late-arrivals/{run_ts}/preview.csv and a small console card with link.

anya: I'll add the invoice-preview toggle PR and update product docs about draft handling.

ops: we can do maintenance 2025-11-20T09:00Z-11:00Z. I'll be available to monitor logs and roll back if alerts fire.

kevin: action list: kevin -> push allowed_lateness change to shadow; sam -> pick canary tenants and alerts; nils -> reconciler dry-run + idempotency; anya -> UI toggle + preview tag; ops -> reserve window and monitor; billing-bot -> publish dashboards/queries.

kevin: thanks all. I'll update with canary list DM and post a short follow-up once shadow run is green. :thumbsup:
